description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance Payable to Workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper crowing and Manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper), which falls under public sector service conditions and benefits administration. It is issued by the Commissioner General of Labour and relates to wage regulations for workers, making it a Public Service matter rather than a government structural/personnel change or any other specialized category.
